node.statement: Harmonic decomposition: write beta_j^+=max(beta_s(j),0), beta_j^-=max(-beta_s(j),0), lambda_j=lambda_s(j), lambda_j^+=max(lambda_j,0), lambda_j^-=max(-lambda_j,0), D_+=sum_j beta_j^+ lambda_j^+, V=sum_j beta_j^+ lambda_j^-, and D_-=sum_j beta_j^- lambda_j. If sum_j beta_s(j)lambda_s(j)=0, then D_+=V+D_- because 0=sum_j (beta_j^+-beta_j^-)(lambda_j^+-lambda_j^-)=(D_+-V)-D_-.
